parts.article:
Bramley Community Centre, how can I help?

Oh, hi. I’m calling about the art classes at the centre office. I had a quick look at your website. I think one of the classes is called something like “movement and light”.

That’s right. The focus is on painting in the style of the French impressionists.

Yes, I saw that in the description, but I’ve got a few questions if you don’t mind.

Sure, go ahead.

Well, do I need to bring anything to the class or is everything supplied?

Not quite. What you need to do is get yourself some brushes. I’d suggest a range of them, you know, in different sizes.

Alright, yes, I guess it would make sense to bring your own. I’ll make a note of that.

And you know what the fee for the class is?

For one term, it’s $170, isn’t it?

That’s right. But if you sign up for two terms, it actually works out cheaper.

How much would that be?

$285. And we do find that a lot of people sign up for a couple of terms. It’s such a great class.

Okay, I’ll give it some thought. And that’s on Monday evenings, isn’t it?

Yes, from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. in room 15.

And who’s the tutor?

The tutor. He’s a local artist. You might have heard of him. Steve Ramdhanie.

Oh, possibly. How do you spell that surname?

It’s R-A-M-D-H-A-N-I-E. Got that? / -Yes, Thanks.

Now you've also got a class called Clay Basics? It's a pottery class, right?

Yes, that's right. Do we get to use a pottery wheel?

Yes, you do.

Oh, great. But we've been making something simple, I hope. I can't imagine producing a vase or anything with a handle.

No, in the first term, you'd just be producing two or three bowls. That means learning how to shape and glaze them.

Sounds great. I guess it would be a bit of a messy activity. You wouldn't want to wear your smart clothes, would you?

Best not to. I'd recommend wearing something old. That you didn't mind getting dirty.

Well, I have a shirt like that that I could use. I'd just roll up the sleeves, I guess.

And the fee for that class is $180 per term.

All right. And the class runs on Wednesdays, 6.30 to 8.30 p.m. Oh, hang on. I've got that wrong.

It's on a Thursday, isn't it?

Yes, my mistake. What else can I tell you? Oh, yes.

The tutor's name is Theresa Clark. Her works on display and reception here.

Oh, great. I'll have a look.

Yeah, if you've got time.

Now, the other class I thought looked interesting was sketching architecture.

Oh, yes. For that one, everyone goes down to the local park because it’s surrounded by so many beautiful old buildings.

All right. Like the old post office.

Well, I think you begin by drawing the library. There’s a good view of it from the park, I believe.

OK, nice. Actually, come to think of it. I think I’ve seen the sketching class down in the park when I’ve driven past. Don’t they all take a fold up chair with them?

I believe so.

Is there anything else I ought to know?

Well, the people who do the class, they tend to make a sandwich for themselves and bring that along. So I’d recommend you do that too.

Good idea. I get grumpy when I’m hungry.

All right. That’s $160 per term for that class. And it’s on Fridays from 11 a.m. till 1.

So if the classes are in the park, that’s quite a big area. Where do we actually meet?

Good point. Everyone usually heads along just before 11 a.m. and they meet each other at the top of Victoria Street at the station road end.

So on the corner, great. And the tutor is...

Annie Lee.

You know what? I’ll have to think about the other two. But I definitely like to enroll for Annie’s class. I’m happy to pay now.

In that case, you’re going to need Annie’s cell phone number in case you’re running late or the class gets cancelled.

I see. OK. What’s the number, please?

It’s 021 785 6361. Just text her if there’s a problem. Now, how would you like to pay?...

analyses.content: 工作人员建议参加绘画课的学员需要自己准备一套不同尺寸的 brushes（画笔）。
What you need to do is get yourself some brushes. I’d suggest a range of them, you know, in different sizes。
听到 bring anything 后注意捕捉具体物品。录音提到 a range of them，说明是复数形式 brushes。
How much would that be? $285. And we do find that a lot of people sign up for a couple of terms。
典型的数字干扰。170 是一个学期的费用，只有报名两个学期（two terms）才是 285。
如果学员一次性报名两个学期的课程，总费用优惠后为 285 美元。
The tutor. He’s a local artist. You might have heard of him. Steve Ramdhanie. It’s R-A-M-D-H-A-N-I-E。
姓名拼写题，注意 H 不要漏掉。听到 How do you spell that surname? 之后需立即记录。
老师的名字是 Steve Ramdhanie，录音中给出了详细的字母拼写。
No, in the first term, you'd just be producing two or three bowls. That means learning how to shape and glaze them。
排除干扰项。学员询问是否做 vase（花瓶），被工作人员否定，明确目标是制作 bowls。
在陶艺基础课的第一个学期，学员们主要学习制作两三个 bowls（碗）。
Well, I have a shirt like that that I could use. I'd just roll up the sleeves, I guess。
工作人员建议穿 something old，学员具体化为 shirt，对应表格中的“Things to bring”。
学员提议穿一件旧的 shirt（衬衫）去参加陶艺课，以防弄脏衣服。
经过纠正，陶艺课的实际授课时间是在 Thursday（周四）晚上。
It's on a Thursday, isn't it? Yes, my mistake。
经典的“信息修正”陷阱。学员先说错为 Wednesdays，随后自己意识到错误（Oh, hang on. I've got that wrong）并更正为 Thursday。
Well, I think you begin by drawing the library. There’s a good view of it from the park, I believe。
听到 starting with（对应题干）之后定位。虽然之前提到了 post office，但那只是学员随口举的例子，不是真正开始画的内容。
建筑速写课会从画当地的 library（图书馆）开始，因为从公园看过去视野很好。
Well, the people who do the class, they tend to make a sandwich for themselves and bring that along。
听到 Things to bring 分类和 hungry 话题后注意捕捉具体的食物名词。
工作人员建议学员自己带一个 sandwich（三明治），因为大家通常都会带午餐。
Everyone usually heads along just before 11 a.m. and they meet each other at the top of Victoria Street at the station road end。
路名听写。听到 corner of 之后，第一个路名是 Victoria Street，第二个路名即答案 Station。
师生们在维多利亚大街和 Station Road 的转角处集合。
In that case, you’re going to need Annie’s cell phone number... It’s 021 785 6361。
电话号码听写需一次性准确记录，注意数字的连贯性。
为了方便联系老师 Annie，学员记录了她的手机号码：0217856361。
